pages.text: A Breeze Rod over three cobblestone. It behaves like a brewing stand: fuel on the left, an ingredient on top, three bottles below.

pages.title: Running it
pages.text:
- Fuel is **Breeze Powder**, one per twenty batches.
- The ingredient slot takes **Crushed Ore**, or plain **Redstone Dust** straight from the ground.
- The three lower slots take **Water Bottles**.  
A batch takes twenty seconds and fills all three bottles at once.
